18 ha estate (11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc; clay/flint); ~62,000 bottles annually, but 2024 gave 48,000 after May hail cut western plots by a fifth. Organic since 2019; biodynamic conversion began 2023, certification earliest 2026. Exports are 41% of sales (Belgium, Japan); Japan requires sulphites under 60 mg/L.

Past failures: 2022 temperature controller drift cost €11,000 (now calibrated pre-harvest, tank 4 has a second probe); 2023 mislabelled vintage led to 900-bottle recall (label proofs need two signatures).

Rules: no irrigation on western plots; harvest dates from three mornings of sugar/acidity readings; tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours.

Open: lighter bottles (importer unconfirmed, no costing); eastern parcel replanting after 2027 undecided (54-year-old vines, yields down 30%).
